sequenceDiagram
    participant P as Port
    participant W as Publish workflow
    participant G as GitHub
    participant R as Resolve workflow
    P->>W: dispatch with skill content
    W->>G: push branch skill/slug
    W->>G: open PR against main
    W->>P: report SUCCESS or FAILED
    P->>R: dispatch merge or close
    R->>G: gh pr merge or close
    R->>P: report result

graph TD
    A["Validate inputs"] --> B["Symlink and open PR"]
    B --> C["Mark suggestion accepted"]
    C --> D["Wait for checks"]
    D --> E{"Checks pass?"}
    E -->|"Yes"| F["Merge and mark applied"]
    E -->|"No"| G["Report FAILED"]
    F --> H["Report to Port"]
    G --> H

sequenceDiagram
    participant M as main
    participant S as sync_plugins
    participant FS as plugins folder
    participant P as Port API
    M->>P: POST auth access_token
    P-->>M: accessToken
    M->>S: sync_plugins
    S->>FS: list plugin folders
    loop each plugin
        S->>FS: resolve skill symlinks
        S->>P: PATCH agentPlugin entity with skills relation
    end
